title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
slides: Why is Apple charging $50 for AI features?
Usage packs extend access beyond free limits
Most users may never hit the cap
Check your usage before buying a pack
Audit your AI spend before renewing
thread_text:
1. $50 for AI? Really?

Apple is charging $50 for AI features that most users won't hit the free limit on. That's a premium for peace of mind, not usage.

2. Usage packs extend access

If you do hit the cap, you can buy packs that extend access beyond the free limits. But here's the twist: most users never get there.

3. Most never hit the cap

Apple's data shows that typical usage stays well below the free threshold. So why pay $50 upfront? Only heavy users see the benefit.

4. Check before you buy

Before buying a pack, check your actual usage. You might be paying for headroom you'll never use. A quick audit could save you $50.

5. Audit your spend today

Open your AI subscription settings and compare your usage against the free limit. If you're under, cancel the pack. Do it now.
